name: AI 换脸
summary: 把第一张图人物的脸换成第二张图里的人脸，其余内容保持不变。
author: Glance

commands.name: 换脸
commands.description: 输入两张图片：第一张是要修改的照片，第二张提供新的人脸，生成换脸后的图片。

privacy.notice: 两张图片将上传至 Glance 及 AI 图像服务处理。 / Both images are uploaded to Glance and an AI image service for processing.

en.name: Face Swap
en.summary: Replace the face in the first photo with the face from the second image; everything else stays the same.

run.name: Face Swap
run.description: Takes two images: the photo to change and the image providing the new face, and returns the photo with the face swapped.
